# @rune-langium/docs

> Documentation site and generated agent skills for rune-langium APIs

## @rune-langium/core

> Parse `.rosetta` source into typed ASTs, build cross-file workspaces, and
serialize models back to source text.

- `declarationDispatch`: Selector text is stable before linking; resolving it here would recursively enter scope construction.
- `setProjectDocumentModel`: Hosts explicitly assign document ownership; core does not infer model identity from names or namespaces.
- `setProjectRedirects`
- `invalidateProjectResolution`: A host must invalidate identity indexes whenever it replaces document roots.
- `clearProjectResolution`
- `hasProjectRedirects`
- `getEffectiveProjectDeclaration`: All consumers select through the same generation-local declaration targets as core linking.
- `projectDeclarationIdentity`
- `redirectProjectNode`: A missing replacement stays unresolved; it must never fall back to the immutable original.
- `redirectProjectScope`: Keep authored lookup names while navigation and linking descriptions point at the effective declaration.
- `declarationKey`: Portable identity key; config and parser hosts share this exact representation.
- `parse`: Parse a Rosetta DSL source string into a typed AST.
- `parseWorkspace`: Parse multiple Rosetta DSL source strings as a workspace.
Cross-references between documents will be resolved after all documents are built.
- `parseExpression`: Synchronously parse a bare Rune DSL expression snippet (e.g. a Condition,
Operation, or ShortcutDeclaration body) into a typed `RosettaExpression`.
- `addLegacyAnnotations`: Add missing legacy declarations to the runtime annotation document before linking.
- `createRuneDslServices`: Create the full set of services required for the Rune DSL language.
- `createRuneDslParser`: Factory function that creates and fully initializes a RuneDslParser.
- `insertImplicitBrackets`: Scans Rune DSL source text and inserts `[` and `]` around bare expressions
that follow `extract`, `filter`, or `reduce` operators.
- `compactLspModelJson`: Keep semantic AST data and declaration ranges, without dependency token spans.
- `readLspModelMetadata`: Read canonical import and resolved-reference edges, including function bodies.
- `runeBigIntReplacer`: Canonical BigInt JSON replacer for Rune wire serialization: bigint → Number.
- `serializeRuneModel`: Serialize a Rune AST model to its canonical wire JSON string.
- `preserveCstText`: Copy `$cstNode.
- `deserializeRuneModel`: Deserialize a serialized Rune AST JSON string back to a `RosettaModel`.
- `hydrateModelDocument`: Deserialize a serialized Rune AST and build a `LangiumDocument`, optionally
registering it.
- `hydrateModelDocuments`: Hydrate and link one shared object graph, regardless of reference depth or input order.
- `getNodeSourceRegion`: Original UTF-16 range, shared by parsed and serialized model consumers.
- `getFunctionImplementationRegion`: Implementation range excludes the signature and retains preceding body comments.
- `getExpressionRegions`: Root expressions in grammar order; indexes address their original owner arrays.
- `findExpressionOwner`: Resolve declaration identity, using the unique base for a function dispatch group.
- `getExpressionOwners`: Unique owners across files, grouped by namespace, declaration name and kind.
- `isOptional`: Whether the cardinality allows zero occurrences (inf == 0).
- `isSingular`: Whether the cardinality forces exactly one (inf == 1 && sup == 1).
- `isPlural`: Whether the cardinality allows more than one instance (sup > 1 or unbounded).
- `isRequired`: Whether the cardinality is required (inf >= 1).
- `toConstraintString`: Produce a human-readable constraint string like "(1..1)", "(0..*)", etc.
- `getOptions`: Get the list of choice options from a Choice type.
- `getEffectiveConditions`: Get conditions that are defined on the Data types within a Choice's options.
- `getChoiceOptionPaths`: Declared option paths, including nested choices; data fields are not choice arms.
- `choiceOptionFieldName`
- `assertValidDocuments`: Publication requires syntax-correct documents with every reference linked.
- `hasGeneratedInput`: Check if an expression node has a generated (synthetic) input marker.
- `setGeneratedInputIfAbsent`: Set the generated input marker on an expression node if not already set.
Returns `true` if the marker was set, `false` if it was already present.
- `getFunctionSignature`: Resolve a dispatch overload to its namespace's base declaration.
- `getOperationArgument`: Resolve an explicit operation input or the input of its enclosing pipeline.
- `resolveOperationType`: Shared operator result-type propagation; symbol lookup belongs to the caller.
- `resolveTypeAliases`: Resolve a declared type without looping through recursive aliases.
- `getFunctionInputs`: Get effective input attributes, including inheritance and dispatch signatures.
- `getFunctionOutput`: Get the effective output attribute, including dispatch signatures and inheritance.
- `getElementNamespace`: Return the dot-separated namespace string for an element whose direct
`$container` is a `RosettaModel`.
- `collectNamespaceDependencies`: Walk every parsed document and return a per-namespace dependency map:
`Map<sourceNamespace, Set<targetNamespace>>`.
- `closeNamespaceDependencies`: Compute the transitive closure of a single source namespace through the
dep map produced by `collectNamespaceDependencies`.
- `qualifiedExportPath`: The canonical Langium scope key for a top-level exported element:
`${namespace}.
- `namespaceFromSource`: Extract the namespace from raw `.rosetta` source text. Returns `''` when no
`namespace` declaration is present (matching the historical callers).
- `namespaceFromModelName`: Normalize a `RosettaModel.
- `expandNamespaceWildcard`: Expand an exact name or dotted-prefix wildcard against known namespaces.
- `indexById`: Build an id→item Map, insertion order preserved. Defaults the key to `item.id`.
- `fromIndex`: Derive the value array from an id→item Map (insertion order).
- `getEnumValues`: Effective enum members, with child declarations overriding inherited names.
- `getExpressionScope`: Describe the existing language-service scope at an expression, without a second resolver.
- `getSourceComments`: Hidden comment tokens, in UTF-16 source coordinates; string literals are not comments.
- `getAnnotationDefinitions`: Scope facts from the actual linked references, without rebuilding import/name resolution.
- `buildImportAliasMap`: One alias may intentionally contribute several namespace prefixes.
- `importAliasCandidates`: Shared by language scopes and views; a real qualified name keeps precedence.
- `buildImportScope`: File-local scope facts shared by language lookup and projected references.
- `importScopeCandidates`: Ordered names for a file scope; bare fallback is for the language's outer scope.
- `relinkReference`: Rebuild authored references through Langium's authoritative scope/link boundary.
- `relinkModelReferences`: Dependency snapshots must stay relinkable after live edits or a project-context transition.
- `DuplicateKeyError`
- `RuneDslAstReflection`
- `RuneDslIndexManager`: Extended IndexManager that supports external registration of exported
symbols without requiring a full document build.
- `RuneDslLinker`: Langium linker that lazily materializes corpus documents stored in a
`DeferredModelProvider` the first time a cross-reference to them is resolved.
- `RuneDslScopeProvider`: Custom scope provider for the Rune DSL.
- `RuneDslValidator`: Custom validator for the Rune DSL.
- `RuneStoreHydrator`: Hydrator variant for the Rune store substrate.
- `RuneDslParser`: Custom Langium parser for the Rune DSL that normalizes lexer input to insert
implicit `[` and `]` brackets around bare expressions after `extract`,...

`@lspeasy/server` `LSPServer`.

- `RuneDocumentUpdateHandler`

and @lspeasy/server.

## @rune-langium/codegen

> Generate TypeScript, Zod, JSON Schema, and form-preview metadata from parsed
Rune DSL documents.

### API

- `generate`: Generate code from one or more parsed Langium documents.
- `generateSelected`: Generate a declaration-scoped export and return the exact selection receipt
used by generation.
- `generatePreviewSchemas`: Generate structured form-preview schemas from one or more parsed Langium documents.
- `createProjectBindingRegistry`: Prepared data and installed callbacks only; this module never reads configuration or loads code.
- `applyProjectPreviewBindings`: Transform every finite definition too, so deferred object expansion uses the same choices.
- `validateProjectPreviewBindings`: Resource constraints supplement the generated Rune validator; missing data is an availability error.
- `projectBindingNames`: Names cannot collide with authored Rune identifiers and remain unique in single-file bundles.
- `projectBindingHeader`
- `bindGeneratedProjectModule`: Attach a prepared registry to a newly loaded generated module; no global registry crosses projects.
- `projectCodeListForAlias`: One adapter guard shared by the graph and all resource-aware generators.
- `resolveNativeImplementation`: Authored Rune bodies win. Match identity, annotation and signature before selecting a target body.
- `normalizePreviewInputs`: Adapt plain form values to the generated function's metadata-bearing input contract.
- `adaptPreviewData`: Normalize canonical object values using the active linked declarations.
- `projectRuneJsonData`: Project canonical Choice slots and concrete Data types before Rune wire metadata encoding.
- `expandPreviewField`: Resolve one deferred object body without expanding its nested references.
- `metadataPreviewField`: Edit a metadata payload's value path while retaining its adjacent keys, scheme and references.
- `previewTypeSymbol`: Canonical presentation identity shared by schema generation, resource bindings and layout consumers.
- `collectDeclarationDependencies`: Direct declaration dependencies through the authoritative effective-reference port.
- `declarationKey`: Stable, kind-aware identity for a selected top-level declaration.
- `resolveExportSelection`: Resolve selected roots and return shallow document views without mutating the linked workspace.
- `unknownExportSelectionDiagnostics`: Shared diagnostic details for stale declaration or namespace export roots.
- `resolveEffectiveProjectTargetId`: Resolve a kind-qualified authored target through core's linked project identity.
- `isWholeModelEmitter`: Runtime discriminator between the two emitter contracts.
- `resolveExcelSheets`: Resolve the effective sheet toggles from a partial/absent options block,
applying the schema defaults.
- `emitStandaloneZodSchema`: Emit one target type's real Zod schema as a self-contained script — the
target's transitive closure (Task 2) assembled into a single synthetic
`Nam...
- `selectTypeScriptProjection`: Select recorded output; display availability is independent of inverse-lens coverage.
- `createPythonProjectionContext`
- `projectPythonFunction`: Complete implementation; the inverse Python lens retains its narrower expression contract.
- `projectPythonCondition`
- `generatePythonModule`: Standalone browser-safe Python source plus source-addressed display fragments.
- `selectPythonProjection`
- `projectPythonExpression`: Forward generation is independent of the deliberately narrower inverse Python lens.
- `validateTargetOptions`
- `getGeneratorCapabilities`
- `getTargetLayouts`
- `ProjectBindingUnavailable`
- `GeneratorError`: Thrown when strict mode is enabled and any error diagnostic is produced.
FR-022.
- `GenericModelEmitter`: Parameterized `WholeModelEmitter` that wraps any `NamespaceEmitter`
plus a `LanguageProfile` (019 spec §3.
- `IMPLEMENTED_TARGETS`: The targets `runGenerate` can actually produce output for in this build.
- `NATIVE_IMPLEMENTATIONS`: Audited generator-owned bodies; never executable source loaded from a workspace.
- `TARGET_DESCRIPTORS`: Registry of all generator targets.
- `ExcelOptionsSchema`
- `RUNTIME_HELPER_JS_SOURCE`: Annotation-free counterpart used by the Studio execution worker.
- `TARGET_OPTIONS_SCHEMAS`

## @rune-langium/visual-editor

> ReactFlow-based graph and form components for exploring and editing Rune DSL
models in the browser.

### API

- `typeRefMimeForKind`: Kind-scoped MIME variant so drop targets can filter by `accept` during
dragover, when the browser security model makes `getData` return empty.
- `isTypeRefPayload`: Type guard for parsed drag payloads.
- `expansionKey`: Serialise an expansion key for use as a Map / Record key.
- `KindBadge`
- `useTypeNavigationMenu`: Targets must already be resolved by the owning link, tree or Structure adapter.
- `TypeHeader`
- `OtherForm`
- `selectionState`: Returns the checkbox state for a collection of selection IDs.
- `toggleVisible`: Adds or removes only the supplied IDs, preserving every other selection.
- `TypeSelector`: Searchable type selector with kind-colored badges.
- `getKindBadgeClasses`: Returns badge CSS classes for a given type kind.
- `getKindDotClass`
- `getKindLabel`: Returns a human-readable label for a type kind.
- `CardinalityPicker`
- `MetadataSection`: Editable and inspection-only targets share the canonical construct capabilities.
- `AttributeRow`
- `DataTypeForm`
- `EnumValueRow`
- `EnumForm`
- `ChoiceOptionRow`
- `ChoiceForm`
- `FunctionForm`
- `astToModel`: Convert RosettaModel AST roots into ReactFlow nodes and edges.
- `modelsToAst`: Convert graph nodes and edges to serializer-compatible model objects.
Groups nodes by namespace and produces one model per namespace.
- `formatCardinality`: Format a RosettaCardinality model as a display string, e.g. `(1..*)`.
- `parseCardinality`: Parse a cardinality display string back to structured form.
- `getTypeRefText`: Get the display name of a type reference (e.g. from a TypeCall).
- `getRefText`: Get display text from a Reference-like object.
- `annotationsToDisplay`: Convert Dehydrated<AnnotationRef>[] to display-friendly objects.
- `conditionsToDisplay`: Convert condition models to display-friendly objects.
- `resolveNodeKind`: Resolve the React-Flow node-kind (`'data' | 'choice' | 'enum' | .
- `computeLayout`: Compute layout positions for ReactFlow nodes using dagre.

Returns a new array of nodes with updated positions.
Does not mutate the input.
- `computeLayoutIncremental`: Compute layout with cache-first strategy.
- `clearLayoutCache`: Clear the entire position cache (call on model reload).
- `computeLayoutAsync`: Compute layout asynchronously.
- `cancelAsyncLayout`: Cancel any in-flight async layout.
- `computeGroupedLayout`: Layout each group independently with dagre, then arrange
groups in a grid pattern.
- `findInheritanceGroups`: Find inheritance-connected groups among the given nodes.
- `buildTypeOptions`: Projects the editor's canonical node repository into type-selector options.
- `isTypeNodeId`: Whether a graph-node id names a declaration valid in a Rune type reference.
- `makeNodeId`: Build a kind-aware graph-node id from a Rune qualified name and AST kind.
- `nameFromNodeId`: The trailing simple name of a node id (everything after the last dot).
- `qualifiedNameFromNodeId`: Recover the Rune qualified name from a graph-node id.
- `splitNodeId`: Split a node id into `{ namespace, name }` by the last dot; namespace is '' when absent.
- `createEditorStore`: Create an isolated zustand editor store instance.
- `selectNodeRepository`: Returns a node repository derived from `nodesById`, memoized on the Map's
identity.
- `ExpressionBuilder`
- `useAutoSave`: Returns a debounced callback that auto-saves the latest value after
`delay` milliseconds of inactivity. Flushes on unmount.
- `useLatestRef`
- `useNavigationArrival`: Brief destination emphasis, independent of selection and camera auto-fitting.
- `useStableKey`
- `useExpressionAutocomplete`
- `useTypeRefDrop`
- `useDiagnosticsForRange`: Returns the highest-severity `RangeDiagnostic` whose range overlaps the
given `astRange`, or `undefined` when no overlap exists.
- `useModelSourceSync`
- `detectCircularInheritance`: Detect whether setting `childId extends parentId` would create a cycle.
- `detectDuplicateName`: Check if a name already exists in the given namespace.
- `validateCardinality`: Validate a cardinality string.
- `detectDuplicateEnumValue`: Check if an enum value name already exists within the specified enum node.
- `validateNotEmpty`: Validate that a name is non-empty after trimming whitespace.

Returns null if valid, or an error message string if invalid.
- `validateIdentifier`: Validate that a name conforms to Rune DSL identifier rules.

Returns null if valid, or an error message string if invalid.
- `validateExpression`: Validate expression syntax with the canonical Rune parser, without linking workspace symbols.
- `validateGraph`: Run all validations on the current graph state and return errors.
- `StructureView`: A focused DOM hierarchy with a single movable root.
- `buildStructureGraph`
- `NameCell`
- `CardinalityCell`
- `typeChipKind`
- `TypePickerCell`
- `expressionScopeFromEntries`: Presentation groups for canonical core scope descriptions.
- `createEditorCommitRegistry`
- `InspectorFrame`: Layout only: providers and editor sessions stay owned by their declaration.
- `InspectorDetailsPane`: A bounded local layout preference; no model, draft or persistence ownership.
- `InspectorInheritanceField`
- `TYPE_REF_PAYLOAD_MIME`: MIME type used for drag-drop payloads.
- `TYPE_REF_KINDS`: Every type kind a namespace-explorer row can carry.
- `RuneTypeGraph`
- `KIND_LABEL`: Canonical kind → full label. The ONE source for kind labels.
- `KIND_LETTER`: Canonical kind → single-letter classifier for the compact glyph shape.
